## Personality

Gertie Pye is known for her dishonest nature and a persistent habit of being late. She is also prone to jealousy, frequently making disparaging remarks about Julia behind her back.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P47](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0047)_

## History

Gertie Pye is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. She attends the school during the period when [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) returns to class and Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) serves as the teacher. Gertie continues her schooling alongside her peers as they grow older, participating in local events such as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) concert.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV.
